name: setas-os-v5
description: Setas OS v5 — Cuaderno de Campo / Formulador de sustratos. HTML/JS/CSS con un único paso de build (esbuild) para simulador-app.jsx — ver ARCHITECTURE.md.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:gates
scripts.test:browser: node e2e/field-qr-capture.browser.cjs && node e2e/history-eligibility.browser.cjs && node e2e/operator-capture.browser.cjs && node e2e/perito-readiness.browser.cjs && node e2e/preparation-snapshot.browser.cjs
scripts.test:gate:pr: node build.test.js && npm test && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:functions: npm run functions:sync && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test tests/functions/*.test.js"
scripts.functions:sync: mkdir -p functions/shared && cp field-events-model.js field-event-contracts.js setas-os-workflow.js batch-sheet.js functions/shared/
